title: Harvest Guide: Cotton
content: Harvesting Cotton: Maturity signs: Bolls turn brownish-black and hard, followed by bursting of 70-80% bolls exposing dry fluffy white seed cotton (kapas); leaves senesce and turn yellowish-bronze.. Moisture at harvest: Seed cotton moisture must be 8% - 10%; pick only when dew has dried completely (after 10:00 AM).. Method: Manual hand-picking in 3-4 pickings at 15-day intervals. Pick clean, trash-free kapas; do not pick damaged/stained bolls along with good kapas (keep yellow stained bolls separate); avoid plastic twine or polypropylene shreds in harvest bags to prevent spinning mill contamination.. Field handling: Spread kapas on clean tarpaulin sheets under sun for 4-6 hours to reduce moisture below 8% before packing into clean cotton bags. Shred stalks with tractor-drawn stubble shredder immediately after final pick to eliminate Pink Bollworm diapause..
citation: ICAR-CICR Nagpur & CIRCOT Mumbai Cotton Harvesting Protocol 2025

title: Harvest Guide: Rice / Paddy
content: Harvesting Rice / Paddy: Maturity signs: 80-85% spikelets on panicles turn golden yellow / straw-colored, while lowest grains on panicle reach hard dough stage; flag leaves turn yellow.. Moisture at harvest: Optimal grain moisture at harvest: 20% - 22% for combine harvesting (prevents grain shattering loss); 18% - 20% for manual sickle harvesting.. Method: Combine harvester with calibrated cylinder speed (700-800 RPM) to prevent cracked kernels; or manual cutting with improved serrated sickle at 5-10 cm above ground level.. Field handling: Do not leave harvested sheaves in standing water; thresh immediately within 24 hours to prevent mould and enzymatic yellowing (stack burning). Sun dry on cement threshing floor or canvas tarpaulin until moisture reaches 13-14%..
citation: ICAR-IIRR Hyderabad & CIPHET Ludhiana Rice Harvesting Guide 2025

title: Harvest Guide: Chilli
content: Harvesting Chilli: Maturity signs: Green chillies: Harvest when pods reach full length, thick wall, and firm dark green texture. Dry red chillies: Harvest when pods turn completely dark red and firm.. Moisture at harvest: Fresh red pods have 70-75% moisture; must be sun-dried until dry pod moisture drops to 10% - 11% (seeds rattle inside pod).. Method: Manual hand plucking with intact pedicel (stalk). Harvest in morning or evening in 4-6 pickings at 10-15 day intervals.. Field handling: Spread on clean polythene sheets or solar polyhouse tunnel dryers. Avoid spreading directly on bare dirt floors to prevent aflatoxin contamination (Aspergillus flavus). Turn pods twice daily..
citation: ICAR-IIHR Bengaluru & Spices Board India Chilli Manual 2025

title: Harvest Guide: Tomato
content: Harvesting Tomato: Maturity signs: Harvest stage depends on market distance: 1. Mature Green (for long distance transport 3-5 days away); 2. Breaker Stage (blossom end shows pinkish-yellow blush, ideal for 2-3 day transport); 3. Pink / Turning (local wholesale); 4. Red Ripe (local retail and immediate processing).. Moisture at harvest: Fresh succulent berry with 93-94% water content.. Method: Gently twist fruit from pedicel stem with calyx intact during early morning cool hours; place in plastic crates with foam lining (avoid stacking crates >4 layers high).. Field handling: Field shade precooling under thatched sheds; sort out scarred, cat-faced, or diseased fruits before packing into 20-kg ventilated plastic crates..

title: Harvest Guide: Wheat
content: Harvesting Wheat: Maturity signs: Entire canopy turns golden yellow; straw dries and turns brittle; grain cannot be dented with thumbnail and snaps with sharp sound when chewed.. Moisture at harvest: Grain moisture at harvest: 14% - 16% (combine harvesting); 12% - 14% for direct manual harvesting.. Method: Combine harvester or reaper-binder; manual harvest using serrated sickles followed by multi-crop thresher.. Field handling: Dry threshed grain on clean sun-drying floors until moisture reaches 10% - 12% before bagging..

title: Harvest Guide: Maize
content: Harvesting Maize: Maturity signs: Black layer (abscission layer) forms at base of grain where it attaches to cob; husk leaves turn completely paper dry and pale straw-brown; grain moisture drops below 25%.. Moisture at harvest: Grain moisture at harvest: 20% - 22% for mechanical cob picker; 22% - 25% for manual cob picking.. Method: Manual dehusking and cob snapping; or maize combine with specialized corn header. Shelling with power maize sheller.. Field handling: Dry cobs in sun for 3-4 days before shelling; dry shelled kernels to 12% moisture to avoid aflatoxin development..

title: Harvest Guide: Groundnut / Peanut
content: Harvesting Groundnut / Peanut: Maturity signs: Foliage turns yellowish with shedding of lower leaves; inner surface of pod shell develops dark brownish-black vascular netting when scraped with fingernail; kernels show characteristic variety seed coat color.. Moisture at harvest: Pod moisture at digging: 30% - 35%; must be dried down to 8% - 9% for safe storage.. Method: Tractor-drawn groundnut digger-shaker-inverter or manual bullock blade puller. Invert plants so pods face upward exposed to sun.. Field handling: Field curing in inverted windrows for 3-5 days until pods rattle; strip pods using mechanical groundnut pod stripper; sun dry on tarpaulin to <9% moisture to prevent Aspergillus aflatoxin..

title: Harvest Guide: Soybean
content: Harvesting Soybean: Maturity signs: 90-95% leaves turn yellow and drop off leaving bare stems with brown pods; pods rattle distinctly when shaken; grain separates easily from pod shell.. Moisture at harvest: Harvest moisture: 13% - 15%; do not harvest below 12% as mechanical cylinder impact splits seed coat and destroys seed germination vigor.. Method: Combine harvester with low cylinder speed (400-500 RPM) or manual harvesting with serrated sickle.. Field handling: Clean, grade and sun dry slowly under partial shade to 9-10% moisture before storing in clean gunny bags..

title: Harvest Guide: Red Gram / Pigeonpea
content: Harvesting Red Gram / Pigeonpea: Maturity signs: 75-80% pods turn dry and brownish-grey; seeds harden inside pods; leaves dry and drop.. Moisture at harvest: Grain moisture at harvest: 14% - 16%; safe storage moisture: 10% - 11%.. Method: Manual cutting of whole plants close to base using sickles; bundle and stack upright on threshing floor for 3-5 days curing.. Field handling: Thresh by beating with sticks or using pulse thresher; winnow and dry grains in sun for 3 days before storage..

title: Harvest Guide: Chickpea / Bengal Gram
content: Harvesting Chickpea / Bengal Gram: Maturity signs: Leaves and pods turn straw-yellow to golden brown; plants become dry and brittle; seeds shake loose inside inflated pods.. Moisture at harvest: Harvest moisture: 12% - 14%; safe storage moisture: 9% - 10%.. Method: Manual pulling or sickle cutting in early morning hours to prevent pod shattering loss.. Field handling: Stack bundles for 3-4 days in sun; thresh with tractor treading or spike-tooth pulse thresher; dry thoroughly..

title: Harvest Guide: Mustard / Rapeseed
content: Harvesting Mustard / Rapeseed: Maturity signs: 75-80% siliquae (pods) turn yellowish-brown; seeds inside pods turn dark reddish-brown to black; stems turn yellow.. Moisture at harvest: Harvest moisture: 14% - 16%; safe storage moisture: 7% - 8%.. Method: Harvest in early morning hours (before 9:00 AM) when dew dampens pods, preventing shattering of siliquae.. Field handling: Tie in bundles and stack in conical stooks for 5-7 days; thresh on clean canvas floor; winnow and sun dry to <8% moisture..

title: Harvest Guide: Sugarcane
content: Harvesting Sugarcane: Maturity signs: Hand refractometer brix reading exceeds 18% - 20% in middle internodes; top-to-bottom brix ratio approaches 0.95 - 1.0 (Brix uniformity); metallic sound upon tapping cane; eyes turn prominent.. Moisture at harvest: Millable cane stalks; sucrose content 12-14%.. Method: Harvest close to ground level using sharp cane billhooks / knives (bottom internodes contain highest sucrose concentration); de-trash green tops cleanly.. Field handling: Supply cane to sugar mill within 24 hours of cutting; delay beyond 24-48 hours causes severe enzymatic inversion of sucrose into glucose and fructose, drastically dropping mill recovery..
citation: ICAR-SBI Coimbatore Sugarcane Maturity & Milling Guide 2025

title: Harvest Guide: Onion
content: Harvesting Onion: Maturity signs: 50% to 70% of plants show 'neck fall' (softening of pseudo-stem top and foliage collapsing to ground); outer bulb scales develop characteristic variety color.. Moisture at harvest: Fresh bulb moisture: 82-85%; outer skin cured down to papery parchment texture.. Method: Manually pull bulbs by hand or loosen with Khurpi in dry weather; avoid bruising bulbs.. Field handling: Field windrow curing: Arrange bulbs in rows so foliage covers lower bulbs protecting them from sunscald for 3-5 days. Then de-top leaving 2.0 - 2.5 cm neck attached to bulb (prevents rot organism entry). Shade cure for 10-12 days on slatted floors..

title: Harvest Guide: Potato
content: Harvesting Potato: Maturity signs: Haulm senescence: Vines turn yellow and naturally collapse; or chemical dehaulming performed 10-15 days before harvest; tuber skin sets firm and does not peel when rubbed with thumb pressure.. Moisture at harvest: Fresh tubers with 78-80% water; skin cured.. Method: Tractor-drawn potato digger-elevator or bullock digger; manual picking into wicker baskets; avoid digging in wet soil.. Field handling: Curing: Heap dug potatoes in heaps (1-1.5 m height) under shade covered with 10 cm dry paddy straw for 10-15 days at 15-20°C and 85-90% RH to allow skin thickening and wound healing before grading and storage..

title: Harvest Guide: Turmeric
content: Harvesting Turmeric: Maturity signs: Foliage turns completely yellow, dries, and withers down to ground level (occurs at 7-9 months after planting depending on variety).. Moisture at harvest: Fresh rhizome moisture: 75-80%; cured dried finger moisture: 8% - 10%.. Method: Cut dry aerial leaves to ground level; plough field with tractor or mould-board plough; lift clumps carefully with pickaxe without damaging rhizomes.. Field handling: Separate mother rhizomes from fingers; clean adhering soil; boil fingers in water or alkaline solution in TNAU/IISR turmeric boilers for 45-60 minutes until soft; sun dry on clean floor for 10-15 days until crisp; polish in mechanical polishing drum..
citation: ICAR-IISR Calicut & PJTSAU Turmeric Processing Manual 2025

title: Harvest Guide: Black Gram / Urad
content: Harvesting Black Gram / Urad: Maturity signs: 80-85% pods turn brownish-black and dry; seeds harden inside pods.. Moisture at harvest: Harvest moisture: 14% - 16%; safe storage moisture: 9% - 10%.. Method: Harvest entire plants close to base using sickles in early morning; or 2-stage pod picking.. Field handling: Sun dry bundles on threshing floor for 3 days; thresh with beaters or mini thresher; winnow and dry to 9% moisture..

title: Storage Protocol: Paddy / Rice
content: Post-Harvest Storage for Paddy / Rice: Safe Moisture: 13.0% - 14.0% (Milled rice: 12.0% - 13.0%). Structures/Hermetic: Baggage warehouse storage: Stack jute/B-twill bags on wooden dunnage crates (15 cm above floor, 60 cm away from walls) in 1-2-1 interlocking stack pattern up to 16 bags high. For hermetic farm storage: 3-layer Purdue Improved Crop Storage (PICS) hermetic bags eliminate oxygen and kill all insects within 21 days.. Pests: Rice Weevil (Sitophilus oryzae), Lesser Grain Borer (Rhyzopertha dominica), Angoumois Grain Moth (Sitotroga cerealella).. Prevention & Celphos norms: WDRA Standard: Warehouse prophylactic spray of Deltamethrin 2.5% WP (40 g/100 sq.m surface) or Malathion 50% EC (1:100 dilution). Curative fumigation: Aluminium Phosphide (Celphos 56%) @ 3 tablets (9 g) per tonne under airtight gas-proof cover for 7 days exposure period strictly by certified pest control operator.. Safe Duration: 12 to 24 months under scientific WDRA warehouse norms..
citation: WDRA Warehousing Standards & FCI Quality Control Manual 2025

title: Storage Protocol: Wheat
content: Post-Harvest Storage for Wheat: Safe Moisture: 10.0% - 12.0%. Structures/Hermetic: Metal silos with aeration blowers; Cover and Plinth (CAP) storage with 250 micron LDPE black covers; or HDPE woven sacks in masonry warehouses.. Pests: Khapra Beetle (Trogoderma granarium), Rust-red Flour Beetle (Tribolium castaneum), Lesser Grain Borer (Rhyzopertha dominica).. Prevention & Celphos norms: Clean warehouses thoroughly; white-wash walls; fill wall crevices. Prophylactic spray of Malathion 50% EC on walls and alleyways. Fumigation with Aluminium Phosphide @ 3 tablets/tonne under gas-proof tarpaulin for 7-10 days.. Safe Duration: 12 to 36 months in airtight silos or WDRA accredited warehouses..

title: Storage Protocol: Pulses (Red Gram, Chickpea, Black Gram, Green Gram)
crop: Pulses (Red Gram, Chickpea, Black Gram, Green Gram)
content: Post-Harvest Storage for Pulses (Red Gram, Chickpea, Black Gram, Green Gram): Safe Moisture: 9.0% - 10.0%. Structures/Hermetic: PICS Hermetic bags (100% effective without chemicals for smallholder farmers); or clean, dry HDPE bags in well-ventilated dry stores.. Pests: Pulse Beetle / Bruchids (Callosobruchus maculatus & Callosobruchus chinensis).. Prevention & Celphos norms: Farm level: Coat clean seed with edible oil (Castor oil or Neem oil @ 5 ml per kg seed) or mix activated neem leaf powder (10 g/kg). Commercial warehouse: Fumigation with Aluminium Phosphide @ 2 tablets/tonne under airtight rubberized sheets.. Safe Duration: 9 to 12 months..

title: Storage Protocol: Groundnut Pods
content: Post-Harvest Storage for Groundnut Pods: Safe Moisture: 7.0% - 8.0%. Structures/Hermetic: Store in pod form rather than shelled kernels; store in gunny bags stacked up to 10 bags high on wooden crates in dry, well-aerated godowns.. Pests: Groundnut Bruchid (Caryedon serratus), Red Flour Beetle (Tribolium castaneum), Aspergillus flavus (aflatoxin mould).. Prevention & Celphos norms: Maintain relative humidity <65% in godown to prevent aflatoxin contamination. Prophylactic dusting of outer bag stacks with Malathion 5% dust. Do not store pods directly on cement floor.. Safe Duration: 6 to 9 months..

title: Storage Protocol: Soybean
content: Post-Harvest Storage for Soybean: Safe Moisture: 9.0% - 10.0%. Structures/Hermetic: Store in breathable multiwall paper or jute bags; do not stack >8 bags high to prevent crushing of lower seeds (which raises free fatty acids FFA).. Pests: Almond Moth (Cadra cautella), Red Flour Beetle.. Prevention & Celphos norms: Keep store temperature below 25°C. High moisture (>12%) triggers rapid oil rancidity and fungal heating.. Safe Duration: 6 to 10 months for seed germination viability..

title: Storage Protocol: Mustard / Rapeseed
content: Post-Harvest Storage for Mustard / Rapeseed: Safe Moisture: 7.0% - 8.0%. Structures/Hermetic: Gunny bags or bulk metal bins in dry moisture-proof godowns.. Pests: Sawtoothed Grain Beetle (Oryzaephilus surinamensis), Cadra cautella.. Prevention & Celphos norms: Moisture above 8% causes rapid oil quality degradation, mould, and heating. Prophylactic warehouse hygiene.. Safe Duration: 12 months..

title: Storage Protocol: Cotton Seed & Cotton Bales (Lint)
content: Post-Harvest Storage for Cotton Seed & Cotton Bales (Lint): Safe Moisture: Cotton seed: 8.0% - 9.0%; Pressed Lint Bales: 7.5% - 8.5%. Structures/Hermetic: Lint bales (170 kg standard Indian bale) stored in covered, fire-protected ginning godowns on wooden planks. Spacing of 1 meter between bale lots with overhead fire hydrants.. Pests: Dampness staining, Aspergillus fungi, fire hazard.. Prevention & Celphos norms: Strict adherence to No Smoking / No Naked Flame rule. Keep godowns well-ventilated and dry.. Safe Duration: 12 to 24 months..

title: Storage Protocol: Dry Red Chilli
content: Post-Harvest Storage for Dry Red Chilli: Safe Moisture: 10.0% - 11.0%. Structures/Hermetic: Cold storage at 4°C - 5°C with 60% - 65% relative humidity preserves vibrant red color, capsanthin pigment, and pungency (capsaicin). Traditional storage: Gunny bags in dark, cool, dry godowns.. Pests: Cigarette Beetle (Lasioderma serricorne), Drugstore Beetle (Stegobium paniceum).. Prevention & Celphos norms: Cold storage prevents color fading (browning) and beetle infestation without chemical fumigation.. Safe Duration: 12 to 18 months in commercial cold stores..
citation: Spices Board India & Guntur APMC Cold Storage Manual 2025

title: Storage Protocol: Onion Bulbs
content: Post-Harvest Storage for Onion Bulbs: Safe Moisture: Cured bulbs: 65% - 70% equilibrium relative humidity. Structures/Hermetic: Naturally ventilated bottom-and-side ventilated modified onion storage structures (Kanda Chawl / DOGR model) with raised bamboo/wire mesh floor (60 cm above ground) and asbestos/thatched roof. Cold storage: 0°C - 2°C with 65% - 70% RH.. Pests: Black Mold (Aspergillus niger), Bacterial Soft Rot (Erwinia carotovora), Sprouting and Desiccation shrinkage.. Prevention & Celphos norms: Spray Maleic Hydrazide (MH) @ 2500 ppm at 15 days before harvest to inhibit post-harvest sprouting in storage. Store only well-cured Rabi onions with thin dry necks; Kharif onions not suitable for long storage.. Safe Duration: 4 to 6 months in DOGR improved ventilated structures; 8 months in cold stores..
citation: ICAR-DOGR Pune Onion Storage Engineering Guide 2025

title: Storage Protocol: Potato Tubers
content: Post-Harvest Storage for Potato Tubers: Safe Moisture: Fresh cured tubers: 90% - 95% relative humidity. Structures/Hermetic: Seed potatoes: Cold storage at 2°C - 4°C with 90-95% RH. Processing potatoes (for chips/french fries): Store at 8°C - 10°C treated with CIPC sprout inhibitor (prevents cold-induced sweetening / reducing sugar build-up that turns chips black).. Pests: Potato Tuber Moth (Phthorimaea operculella), Dry Rot (Fusarium spp.), Soft Rot.. Prevention & Celphos norms: Farm storage: Cover cured tubers with 2-3 cm dry sand layer to block PTM oviposition. In cold store: Fogging with CIPC (Isopropyl N-(3-chlorophenyl)carbamate) @ 40 ml/tonne.. Safe Duration: 7 to 9 months in modern cold storage..
citation: ICAR-CPRI Shimla Potato Cold Storage Protocol 2025

title: Storage Protocol: Turmeric Dried Rhizomes
content: Post-Harvest Storage for Turmeric Dried Rhizomes: Safe Moisture: 8.0% - 10.0%. Structures/Hermetic: Polished cured finger rhizomes packed in double gunny bags lined with polythene; or traditional underground pit storage (Khani) plastered with cow dung and clay.. Pests: Cigarette Beetle (Lasioderma serricorne), Coffee Bean Weevil (Araecerus fasciculatus).. Prevention & Celphos norms: Fumigation with Aluminium Phosphide @ 2 tablets/tonne under airtight cover. Store in cool, dark room to avoid curcumin photo-degradation.. Safe Duration: 12 to 24 months..

title: Storage Protocol: Maize Grain
content: Post-Harvest Storage for Maize Grain: Safe Moisture: 12.0%. Structures/Hermetic: Metal silos or polypropylene woven bags stacked on dunnage in rodent-proof godowns.. Pests: Maize Weevil (Sitophilus zeamais), Angoumois Grain Moth, Aspergillus flavus.. Prevention & Celphos norms: Moisture must be strictly below 12% to prevent deadly aflatoxin B1 accumulation. Prophylactic Deltamethrin spray; Celphos fumigation as per WDRA standards.. Safe Duration: 12 months..

title: Agromet Bulletin: imd-agro-001
content: IMD Agromet Advisory [imd-agro-001] for Warangal & Khammam, Central Telangana Zone. Scenario: Continuous Overcast Skies with Drizzling Rain & High Relative Humidity (>85%, 24-28°C). Affected Crops: ['Rice / Paddy', 'Cotton', 'Chilli']. Impact: Prolonged leaf wetness (>6 hours) and high humidity trigger explosive outbreaks of Rice Blast (leaf and neck blast), Sheath Blight, and Cotton Grey Mildew (Dahiya).. Advisories: Postpone all chemical spraying until skies clear and rain stops. Drain excess water from rice fields to prevent sheath blight upward progression. Hold back top-dressing of chemical nitrogenous fertilizers (Urea) as excessive N escalates fungal blast virulence. Keep prophylactic fungicides ready: Spray Amistar Top (Azoxystrobin + Difenoconazole) @ 1 ml/L or Contaf (Hexaconazole 5% SC) @ 2 ml/L once rain recedes..
citation: IMD Agromet Advisory Bulletin, RMC Hyderabad & PJTSAU 2025

title: Agromet Bulletin: imd-agro-002
content: IMD Agromet Advisory [imd-agro-002] for Kurnool & Anantapur, Scarce Rainfall Zone (Rayalaseema, AP). Scenario: Dry Spell of 18-20 Days during July-August with Max Temp 35-38°C. Affected Crops: ['Groundnut / Peanut', 'Cotton', 'Red Gram']. Impact: Severe moisture stress during groundnut flowering and pegging stage causing peg hardening and floral abortion; jassid and thrips flare-up in cotton.. Advisories: Operate tractor-drawn or bullock-drawn blade harrow (Danti) in inter-rows to create a dust mulch (soil mulch) which breaks capillary moisture loss from soil. Apply supplemental protective irrigation using rain-gun or sprinkler systems. Give foliar spray of 2% Urea (20 g/L) or 2% Potassium Nitrate (KNO3 @ 20 g/L) in early morning or late afternoon to relieve crop water stress..
citation: IMD District Agro-Meteorological Advisory Unit (DAMU) Anantapur & ANGRAU 2025

title: Agromet Bulletin: imd-agro-003
content: IMD Agromet Advisory [imd-agro-003] for Ludhiana & Patiala, Central Plain Zone, Punjab. Scenario: Terminal Heat Wave (Max Temp >35°C, 4-5°C above normal) during March (Grain Filling Stage). Affected Crops: ['Wheat']. Impact: Terminal heat stress shortens grain-filling duration, induces forced maturity, and causes grain shriveling, reducing 1000-grain test weight and wheat yield by 15-25%.. Advisories: Provide light and frequent sprinkler irrigations during evening hours to moderate microclimate canopy temperature. Foliar spray of 0.2% Potassium Nitrate (KNO3 @ 2 g/L) or 0.2% Alpha-tocopherol at heading and milk stage to enhance thermotolerance. Avoid flooding fields during windy afternoon hours to prevent crop lodging..
citation: PAU Ludhiana & IMD Agromet Advisory Service New Delhi 2025

title: Agromet Bulletin: imd-agro-004
content: IMD Agromet Advisory [imd-agro-004] for Hisar & Karnal, Western Plain Zone, Haryana. Scenario: Severe Cold Wave & Ground Frost Alert (Minimum Temp dropping below 3.0°C in January). Affected Crops: ['Potato', 'Mustard', 'Tomato']. Impact: Intracellular ice crystal formation leads to cellular rupture, blackened foliage, premature flower drop in mustard, and complete frost blighting of potato vines.. Advisories: Provide light irrigation to crops in evening hours; water has high specific heat capacity and raises soil and canopy temperature by 1-2°C. Create evening smoke around field boundaries (smudging) using dry leaves/straw on the windward side between 11 PM and 5 AM. Spray soluble sulphur (80% WDG) @ 2.5 g/L or dilute sulphuric acid (0.1% H2SO4) on standing mustard/potato..
citation: IMD Agromet Advisory Unit Chandigarh & CCSHAU Hisar 2025

title: Agromet Bulletin: imd-agro-005
content: IMD Agromet Advisory [imd-agro-005] for Guntur & Krishna, Krishna-Godavari Delta Zone, AP. Scenario: Bay of Bengal Depressions / Cyclone Warning with Heavy Rainfall (150-250 mm in 48 hours). Affected Crops: ['Paddy (Harvesting stage)', 'Cotton (Boll opening stage)', 'Chilli']. Impact: Water stagnation, field submergence, lodging of ripe paddy panicles, viviparous grain germination, and rotting of mature cotton bolls.. Advisories: Harvest mature standing paddy immediately if crop is at 80-85% maturity and store sheaves in safe elevated sheds. Open drainage channels and clear field bund outlets immediately to drain standing storm runoff. For logged ripe paddy fields, spray 5% common salt solution (NaCl @ 50 g/L) on standing panicles to suppress in-situ viviparous sprouting. Do not apply any fertilizer or chemical sprays until water recedes completely..
citation: Cyclone Warning Centre Visakhapatnam & ANGRAU Amaravati 2025

title: Agromet Bulletin: imd-agro-006
content: IMD Agromet Advisory [imd-agro-006] for Indore & Ujjain, Malwa Plateau Zone, Madhya Pradesh. Scenario: Excessive Rainfall Cloudburst (>100 mm in 24 hours) during Sowing Window (July). Affected Crops: ['Soybean', 'Maize']. Impact: Vertisol soil saturation and water ponding; seed rot and asphyxiation of germinating soybean seedlings.. Advisories: Construct Broad Bed Furrows (BBF) across slopes so excess rainwater drains rapidly into furrows. If seeds rot and plant stand falls below 60% of optimal, re-sow with early maturing soybean varieties (JS 95-60, NRC 37) as soon as soil permits workable tilth. Drench collar root zone with Carbendazim 50% WP @ 2 g/L to prevent collar rot..

title: Agromet Bulletin: imd-agro-007
content: IMD Agromet Advisory [imd-agro-007] for Nashik & Pune, Western Maharashtra Plain Zone. Scenario: Unseasonal Spring Hailstorm with Gusty Squally Winds (>60 km/h) in February-March. Affected Crops: ['Onion', 'Tomato', 'Wheat']. Impact: Physical mechanical injury, shredding of foliage, lodging of wheat, and bruised onion bulbs prone to secondary bacterial rotting.. Advisories: Deploy anti-hail protective netting over high-value vegetable and onion seed crops. Immediately after hailstorm, spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/L + Streptocycline @ 0.1 g/L to heal tissue wounds and prevent bacterial soft rot. Provide light irrigation to wash off dirt and encourage vegetative recovery..
citation: MPKV Rahuri & IMD Pune Agromet Advisory 2025

title: Agromet Bulletin: imd-agro-008
content: IMD Agromet Advisory [imd-agro-008] for Nizamabad & Jagtial, Northern Telangana Zone. Scenario: High Day Temperatures (>36°C) & Clear Skies during Rabi Paddy Nursery (December-January). Affected Crops: ['Rice / Paddy Nursery']. Impact: Cold night temperatures (<12°C) combined with dry winds cause stunted yellow seedlings (cold injury) in rabi nursery.. Advisories: Keep thin layer of water (2-3 cm) in nursery bed during night to insulate roots against chilling, and drain in morning. Cover nursery beds with polythene sheets supported by bamboo arches during night (greenhouse cover effect). Spray 0.5% Zinc Sulphate + 1% Urea to boost seedling vigor..
citation: PJTSAU Regional Agricultural Research Station Jagtial 2025

title: Agromet Bulletin: imd-agro-009
content: IMD Agromet Advisory [imd-agro-009] for Bharatpur & Alwar, Flood Plain Zone, Eastern Rajasthan. Scenario: Warm, Humid & Cloudy Weather in January (RH >75%, Temp 15-20°C). Affected Crops: ['Mustard / Rapeseed']. Impact: Ideal environmental trigger for rapid immigration and explosive proliferation of Mustard Aphid (Lipaphis erysimi) and White Rust outbreak.. Advisories: Scout crop daily; check central shoot inflorescence for aphid colonies. If aphid infestation exceeds 20% plants, spray Actara 25% WG (Thiamethoxam) @ 40 g/acre or Dimethoate 30% EC @ 260 ml/acre during late afternoon hours after honeybees return to hives. Spray Ridomil Gold @ 2 g/L if white rust porcelain pustules appear on lower leaves..

title: Agromet Bulletin: imd-agro-010
content: IMD Agromet Advisory [imd-agro-010] for Shimla & Solan, Sub-Temperate Hill Zone, Himachal Pradesh. Scenario: Dense Fog, Continuous Drizzle & Relative Humidity >95% for 72 Hours (Temp 10-18°C). Affected Crops: ['Potato', 'Tomato']. Impact: Late Blight Forecasting Alert: 100% favorable conditions for Phytophthora infestans epidemic.. Advisories: Apply prophylactic contact fungicide Dithane M-45 (Mancozeb 75% WP) @ 2.5 g/L immediately covering lower and upper leaf surfaces. If disease lesions have already appeared, spray curative systemic fungicide Ridomil Gold (Metalaxyl-M + Mancozeb) @ 2.5 g/L without delay. High earthing up to protect developing tubers from zoospores washing down..
citation: ICAR-CPRI Shimla Late Blight Forecasting Warning 2025

title: Agromet Bulletin: imd-agro-011
content: IMD Agromet Advisory [imd-agro-011] for Nagpur & Wardha, Vidarbha Zone, Maharashtra. Scenario: Prolonged Intermittent Showers during October-November (Boll Bursting Stage). Affected Crops: ['Cotton']. Impact: Moisture inside bursting bolls causes wet boll rot, internal fiber discoloration, seed sprouting, and severe lint staining.. Advisories: Pick burst bolls immediately during sunny intervals; dry kapas thoroughly on tarpaulin. Spray Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 2.5 g/L + Streptocycline @ 0.1 g/L on green bolls to prevent secondary fungal and bacterial boll rots. Remove rotting ground bolls to prevent inoculum build-up..
citation: ICAR-CICR Nagpur & PDKV Akola Agromet Advisory 2025

title: Agromet Bulletin: imd-agro-012
content: IMD Agromet Advisory [imd-agro-012] for Cuttack & Puri, East Coast Plain Zone, Odisha. Scenario: Post-Monsoon Northeast Monsoon Cyclonic Rainstorms (November). Affected Crops: ['Rice / Paddy', 'Winter Vegetables']. Impact: Flash flooding of coastal lowlands; submergence of standing paddy crop close to harvest.. Advisories: Drain inundated fields rapidly using diesel pump-sets. Harvest submerged panicles immediately, wash muddy grains with clean water, and sun-dry. Spray 19:19:19 @ 10 g/L on surviving winter vegetables to revive vegetative growth after flood waters recede..

title: Contingency Advisory: cont-001
content: Contingency Plan [cont-001]: Delayed Monsoon Onset by 2-3 Weeks (Sowing Window Shifted to Mid-July). Region & Crops: Telangana & Andhra Pradesh: Cotton, Maize, Groundnut. Action Plan: Continue with normal cotton hybrids until July 15. If sowing delayed beyond July 15, switch to short-duration cotton or alternate crops like Maize (DHM 117), Soybean, or Red Gram. Adopt Broad Bed and Furrow (BBF) or ridge-furrow planting to conserve rainwater. Seed treatment with biofertilizers (Azotobacter and PSB) to accelerate early root establishment.. Rationale: Late-sown cotton experiences terminal drought and bollworm flare-up during flowering; switching to maize or soybean maintains farm profitability..

title: Contingency Advisory: cont-002
content: Contingency Plan [cont-002]: Severe Monsoon Delay by 4-6 Weeks (No Sowing Till August 1st Week). Region & Crops: Deccan Plateau & Central India Drylands: Rainfed Tracts. Action Plan: Completely abandon Cotton, Groundnut, and Soybean for rainfed tracts. Switch to ultra-short duration contingency crops: Sunflower (DRSF 108), Castor (DCH 519), Pearl Millet (Bajra ICTP 8203), Green Gram (Mung WGG 42), Horse Gram (Ulavalu), or Fodder Sorghum. Reduce seed rate by 15-20% and increase inter-row spacing to minimize canopy water competition.. Rationale: Short-duration oilseeds and pulses mature within 65-80 days using remaining post-monsoon soil moisture..
citation: ICAR-CRIDA National Contingency Plan for Agricultural Drought 2025

title: Contingency Advisory: cont-003
content: Contingency Plan [cont-003]: Mid-Season Drought / Dry Spell of 20-25 Days During Vegetative Stage (August). Region & Crops: All Rainfed Crops (Cotton, Soybean, Red Gram, Groundnut). Action Plan: Perform shallow intercultural harrowing (dust mulching) to break surface capillary pores and arrest evaporation. Spray anti-transpirants: Foliar spray of 2% Potassium Nitrate (KNO3 @ 20 g/L) or 1% Urea to maintain leaf cell turgor. Remove alternate rows of crop for fodder if extreme drought threatens total crop desiccation. Apply life-saving supplemental irrigation through micro-sprinklers from farm ponds (Krishi Honda).. Rationale: KNO3 spray induces partial stomatal closure, reducing transpiration while supplying vital potassium for osmotic adjustment..

title: Contingency Advisory: cont-004
content: Contingency Plan [cont-004]: Terminal Drought / Early Monsoon Withdrawal During Reproductive Stage (September-October). Region & Crops: Kharif Rainfed Crops: Cotton, Red Gram, Maize. Action Plan: Give single life-saving irrigation at flowering/pod set from harvested farm pond water. Foliar spray of 2% DAP (20 g/L) + 1% Potassium Chloride (MOP 10 g/L) in evening hours. Harvest maize for green fodder or cob silage if grain formation is severely impaired.. Rationale: Direct nutrient feeding through leaf stomata bypasses dried-up root zone where nutrient uptake has halted..

title: Contingency Advisory: cont-005
content: Contingency Plan [cont-005]: Flash Floods & Waterlogging in Standing Kharif Crops (August-September). Region & Crops: River basins & canal command areas: Rice, Cotton, Maize. Action Plan: Drain standing flood water from fields within 24-48 hours by opening drain cuts. Once water drains, apply a booster foliar spray of 19:19:19 @ 10 g/L + Urea @ 10 g/L to revive root respiration and nitrogen assimilation. Drench collar region with Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 3 g/L to prevent secondary fungal collar rots in cotton/vegetables. Top dress 25 kg Urea + 15 kg MOP per acre after 4-5 days of drainage.. Rationale: Waterlogged roots suffer acute oxygen starvation (hypoxia); foliar nutrients supply immediate sustenance until roots resume aeration..

title: Contingency Advisory: cont-006
content: Contingency Plan [cont-006]: Unseasonal Rainfall at Paddy Harvest Time (November-December). Region & Crops: Coastal Andhra, Telangana, Odisha: Rice / Paddy. Action Plan: Spray 5% common salt solution (NaCl @ 50 g/L) on mature standing panicles or harvested sheaves to prevent grain germination. Stack harvested sheaves with panicles pointing inwards and covered with tarpaulin. Shift harvested produce to community solar poly-dryers or WDRA warehouse drying floors.. Rationale: Common salt solution dehydrates grain husk surface, creating osmotic barrier that inhibits viviparous embryo germination..

title: Contingency Advisory: cont-007
content: Contingency Plan [cont-007]: Severe Heatwave during Rabi Wheat Flowering & Grain Filling (March). Region & Crops: Punjab, Haryana, Rajasthan, MP: Wheat. Action Plan: Provide light evening irrigations through sprinklers to maintain micro-environment canopy humidity. Spray 0.2% Potassium Nitrate (2 g/L) or 0.2% Salicylic acid (200 ppm) at boot and anthesis stages. Avoid full flood irrigation during afternoon winds to prevent massive lodging.. Rationale: Exogenous salicylic acid and potassium stimulate antioxidant enzyme activity, detoxifying reactive oxygen species (ROS)..
citation: ICAR-IIWBR Karnal Terminal Heat Mitigation Protocol 2025

title: Contingency Advisory: cont-008
content: Contingency Plan [cont-008]: Sudden Fall Armyworm (FAW) Surge in Maize Whorls. Region & Crops: Telangana, Karnataka, Bihar, MP: Kharif & Rabi Maize. Action Plan: Apply neem cake powder or dry soil/sand mixed with ash (9:1 ratio) directly into central leaf whorls. Release egg parasitoid Telenomus remus @ 40,000/acre. If whorl damage exceeds 10%, spray Coragen 18.5% SC (Chlorantraniliprole) @ 80 ml/acre (6 ml per 15L pump) directed into whorl funnel using single nozzle.. Rationale: Physical abrasive action of sand/ash disrupts caterpillar cuticle, while targeted chemical drenching reaches hidden larvae..

title: Contingency Advisory: cont-009
content: Contingency Plan [cont-009]: Pink Bollworm Flare-up in Bt Cotton (Exceeding 8 moths/trap/night). Region & Crops: Telangana, Maharashtra, Gujarat, Haryana: Cotton. Action Plan: Pluck and destroy rosette flowers containing larvae manually twice a week. Install 8-10 pheromone traps/acre for mass annihilation. Foliar spray of Proclaim 5% SG (Emamectin Benzoate) @ 88 g/acre (6.6 g per 15L pump) or Delegate 11.7% SC (Spinetoram) @ 170 ml/acre in evening. Strictly terminate crop by December 31; DO NOT extend crop into ratoon or fourth picking.. Rationale: Terminating crop by December starves the overwintering diapause larvae, breaking pest cycle for succeeding season..

title: Contingency Advisory: cont-010
content: Contingency Plan [cont-010]: Ground Frost / Cold Wave Threat in Rabi Potato & Mustard (January). Region & Crops: Northern India Plains: UP, Haryana, Punjab, Rajasthan. Action Plan: Give light evening irrigation to raise soil heat content. Smudging (smoke generation) around field borders on north-west windward side. Spray 0.1% Thiourea (1 g/L) or 0.1% Sulphuric acid on foliage.. Rationale: Warm smoke cloud acts as thermal blanket reflecting radiant infrared terrestrial heat back to crop canopy..

title: Contingency Advisory: cont-011
content: Contingency Plan [cont-011]: High Canal Water Deficit in Rabi Season (Tail-End Canal Command). Region & Crops: Canal commands: Telangana, AP, Karnataka. Action Plan: Replace high water-requiring Rabi Paddy (1200 mm) with dryland Irrigated Dry (ID) crops: Groundnut (450 mm), Chickpea (250 mm), Maize (500 mm), or Black Gram (300 mm). Adopt Alternate Wetting and Drying (AWD) if paddy has already been transplanted.. Rationale: ID crops require 60-75% less water than flooded paddy and generate higher net return per unit water consumed..

title: Contingency Advisory: cont-012
content: Contingency Plan [cont-012]: Acute Fertilizer Shortage / High Urea Price Shock. Region & Crops: All Agricultural Zones. Action Plan: Replace 25% chemical urea with Nano Urea (liquid) foliar spray @ 4 ml/L at active tillering and panicle initiation. Use Neem Coated Urea (NCU) with split application (3 splits) to minimize leaching and volatilization loss. Incorporate biofertilizers (Azotobacter, Azospirillum, PSB) @ 1 kg/acre mixed in FYM.. Rationale: Nano Urea has >80% nitrogen use efficiency compared to 30-40% for conventional granular urea..
citation: Ministry of Agriculture & IFFCO Nano Urea Guidelines 2025

title: Contingency Advisory: cont-013
content: Contingency Plan [cont-013]: Hailstorm Damage in Fruiting Vegetables & Onions (February-March). Region & Crops: Maharashtra, MP, Telangana: Tomato, Chilli, Onion. Action Plan: Remove broken, smashed branches and rotting fruits immediately. Spray Copper Oxychloride @ 2.5 g/L + Streptocycline @ 0.1 g/L within 24 hours to prevent wound pathogens. Apply foliar spray of micronutrients + 1% Urea to stimulate new lateral branching.. Rationale: Hail cuts create open infection courts for Alternaria and bacterial rots; copper bactericide seals torn margins..

title: Contingency Advisory: cont-014
content: Contingency Plan [cont-014]: Sudden Brown Plant Hopper (BPH) Outbreak in Booting Paddy. Region & Crops: Telangana, AP, Punjab, Haryana: Rice / Paddy. Action Plan: Drain standing water completely from field for 3-4 days to expose base of hills to sunlight and air. Form alleys (walking pathways) by parting plant hills every 8-10 rows. Spray Chess 50% WG (Pymetrozine) @ 120 g/acre (9 g per 15L pump) or Token 20% SG (Dinotefuran) @ 100 g/acre directed strictly at plant bases.. Rationale: Drying field breaks humid microclimate required for hopper nymph development..

title: Contingency Advisory: cont-015
content: Contingency Plan [cont-015]: Terminal Heat & Rust Surge in Late Sown Wheat. Region & Crops: North-Western Plains: Wheat. Action Plan: Spray Tilt 25% EC (Propiconazole) @ 200 ml/acre (15 ml per 15L pump) at first appearance of stripe rust pustules. Spray 0.2% Potassium Nitrate at milking stage. Maintain light soil moisture with frequent shallow irrigations.. Rationale: Propiconazole halts urediniospore germination, while potassium strengthens cell wall thickness against drought/heat..

content: Regional Agronomy for South-Western Semi-Arid Zone (Uttar Pradesh), HQ: Bichpuri Zonal Research Station, Agra. Districts: ['Agra', 'Mathura', 'Firozabad', 'Mainpuri', 'Aligarh', 'Hathras', 'Etah']. Soil: Alluvial Sandy Loams with calcareous kankar layers. Recommended Varieties: {'potato': 'Kufri Bahar (3797), Kufri Anand, Kufri Mohan', 'mustard': 'Rohini, Maya, Varuna, NRCHB 101', 'pearl_millet_bajra': 'Proagro 9444, HHB 67 Improved', 'wheat': 'HD 2967, PBW 502, WH 147'}. Advisories: Dehaulming (cutting vines) of potato at 75-80 DAP hardens skin and prepares tubers for cold storage. Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2 g/L preventively in potato and mustard before expected foggy weather to arrest late blight/white rust. Gypsum application @ 1 tonne/acre in sodic canal patches improves infiltration..
citation: CSA University of Agriculture & Technology Kanpur 2025

title: Regional Package: North Saurashtra Agro-Climatic Zone
content: Regional Agronomy for North Saurashtra Agro-Climatic Zone (Gujarat), HQ: Junagadh Agricultural University (JAU), Junagadh & Targhadia. Districts: ['Rajkot', 'Jamnagar', 'Morbi', 'Surendranagar', 'Amreli', 'Bhavnagar']. Soil: Medium Black to Shallow Calcareous Soils (80%). Recommended Varieties: {'groundnut': 'GG 20, GJG 22, GG 7, TG 37A', 'cotton': 'G.Cot.Hy.8, Shankar 6, Bt hybrids', 'castor': 'GCH 7, GCH 9, GAUCH 1', 'sesame': 'Gujarat Til 2, Gujarat Til 3'}. Advisories: Apply Ferrous Sulphate (FeSO4) @ 5 g/L + Citric acid @ 1 g/L for lime-induced iron chlorosis in groundnut. Dry sowing of groundnut 3-4 days before anticipated monsoon onset maximizes growing period. Pheromone trap monitoring for Spodoptera litura in groundnut..

title: Regional Package: Northern Dry Zone (Zone 3)
content: Regional Agronomy for Northern Dry Zone (Zone 3) (Karnataka), HQ: University of Agricultural Sciences (UAS), Dharwad & Vijayapura. Districts: ['Vijayapura', 'Bagalkote', 'Gadag', 'Koppal', 'Belagavi eastern parts', 'Ballari']. Soil: Medium to Deep Black Vertisols (70%), Red Loams (30%). Recommended Varieties: {'rabi_sorghum': 'M 35-1 (Maldandi), Bimbas, CSV 29R', 'bengal_gram': 'JAKI 9218, Annigeri 1, BGD 103', 'sunflower': 'KBSH 41, KBSH 44, RSFH 1887', 'pomegranate': 'Bhagawa'}. Advisories: Compartmental bunding before monsoon ensures deep moisture recharge in vertisols for rabi chickpea/sorghum. Nipping in chickpea at 35 DAS boosts pod branching. Foliar spray of 1% KNO3 during dry spells prevents wilting in rabi pulses..
citation: UAS Dharwad Package of Practices for Dryland Agriculture 2025

title: KCC FAQ: kcc-faq-001 (Cotton)
content: Farmer Query: My cotton leaves are turning red between veins and dropping. What is the cause and remedy? (Telugu: నా పత్తి చేనులో ఆకులు ఈనెల మధ్య ఎర్రగా మారి రాలిపోతున్నాయి. కారణం మరియు నివారణ ఏమిటి?, Hindi: मेरे कपास के खेत में पत्तियां नसों के बीच लाल होकर गिर रही हैं। इसका क्या कारण और उपाय है?). Crop: Cotton. Category: Nutrient Deficiency. Scientific Solution: This is Magnesium deficiency (leaf reddening). Spray Magnesium Sulphate (MgSO4) @ 10 g/L (1%) + Urea @ 10 g/L twice at 15-day intervals. Ensure soil is moist during spraying..
citation: Kisan Call Center (KCC) Query Resolution Corpus & PJTSAU 2025

title: KCC FAQ: kcc-faq-002 (Rice / Paddy)
content: Farmer Query: Circular dried burnt patches are appearing in my paddy field, and plants are turning golden yellow at base. What should I spray? (Telugu: వరి చేనులో అక్కడక్కడ గుండ్రంగా ఎండిపోయిన మచ్చలు (సుడులు) ఏర్పడుతున్నాయి, మొదళ్లలో పురుగులు ఉన్నాయి. ఏమి పిచికారీ చేయాలి?, Hindi: धान के खेत में जगह-जगह गोल सूखे जले हुए धब्बे बन रहे हैं और पौधे नीचे से सूख रहे हैं। क्या छिड़काव करें?). Crop: Rice / Paddy. Category: Pest Management. Scientific Solution: This is Brown Plant Hopper (BPH) 'hopper burn'. Drain field water immediately for 3-4 days. Form walking alleys. Spray Chess 50% WG (Pymetrozine) @ 120 g/acre (9 g per 15L pump) or Token 20% SG (Dinotefuran) @ 100 g/acre directed strictly at plant bases. Never spray synthetic pyrethroids..

title: KCC FAQ: kcc-faq-003 (Chilli)
content: Farmer Query: My chilli plant top leaves are curling upwards into boat shapes and turning bronzed. What is the problem? (Telugu: మిరప పై ఆకులు పైకి ముడుచుకుని పడవ ఆకారంలో మారుతున్నాయి. నివారణ ఏమిటి?, Hindi: मिर्च के ऊपरी पत्ते ऊपर की ओर नाव की तरह मुड़ रहे हैं। क्या उपाय करें?). Crop: Chilli. Category: Pest Management. Scientific Solution: This is Chilli Thrips (Scirtothrips dorsalis) infestation. Install blue sticky traps @ 15-20 traps/acre. Spray Pegasus 50% WP (Diafenthiuron) @ 240 g/acre (18 g per 15L pump) or Delegate 11.7% SC (Spinetoram) @ 180 ml/acre (13.5 ml per 15L pump)..

title: KCC FAQ: kcc-faq-004 (Chilli)
content: Farmer Query: Chilli leaves are curling downwards like an inverted cup with thickened texture. What spray is needed? (Telugu: మిరప ఆకులు కిందకు ముడుచుకుని ముదురు ఆకుపచ్చగా మొద్దుబారుతున్నాయి. ఏమి కొట్టాలి?, Hindi: मिर्च के पत्ते नीचे की ओर उल्टे कप की तरह मुड़ रहे हैं। क्या छिड़काव करें?). Crop: Chilli. Category: Pest Management. Scientific Solution: Downwards curling indicates Yellow Mites (Polyphagotarsonemus latus). Spray Oberon 22.9% SC (Spiromesifen) @ 200 ml/acre (15 ml per 15L pump) or Wettable Sulphur 80% WDG @ 3 g/L covering underside of leaves..

title: KCC FAQ: kcc-faq-005 (Tomato)
content: Farmer Query: Tomato fruits show large black sunken rot at bottom blossom end. Is this disease? (Telugu: టమోటా కాయల అడుగుభాగంలో నల్లటి మచ్చ ఏర్పడి కుళ్ళిపోతున్నాయి. ఇది తెగులా?, Hindi: टमाटर के फलों के नीचे काला धब्बा पड़कर फल सड़ रहे हैं। क्या यह कोई बीमारी है?). Crop: Tomato. Category: Physiological Disorder. Scientific Solution: This is Blossom End Rot (BER), a physiological calcium deficiency caused by irregular irrigation. Maintain uniform soil moisture. Foliar spray of Calcium Nitrate @ 5 g/L weekly during fruit enlargement..

title: KCC FAQ: kcc-faq-006 (Rice / Paddy)
content: Farmer Query: Rice leaves have spindle-shaped spots with grey center and brown border. How to control? (Telugu: వరి ఆకులపై కంటి ఆకారపు మచ్చలు వచ్చాయి, అంచులు ఎర్రగా మధ్యలో బూడిద రంగులో ఉన్నాయి. ఎలా నివారించాలి?, Hindi: धान के पत्तों पर नाव या आँख के आकार के धब्बे बने हैं। कैसे रोकें?). Crop: Rice / Paddy. Category: Disease Management. Scientific Solution: This is Rice Blast (Magnaporthe oryzae). Avoid excessive urea. Spray Amistar Top (Azoxystrobin + Difenoconazole) @ 200 ml/acre (15 ml per 15L pump) or Nativo 75% WG @ 80 g/acre in 200 L water..

title: KCC FAQ: kcc-faq-007 (Maize)
content: Farmer Query: Maize central leaf whorls are full of sawdust-like frass and large holes. What to do? (Telugu: మొక్కజొన్న సుడులలో రంధ్రాలు పడి రంపపు పొట్టు లాంటి మలంతో నిండిపోయాయి. పురుగు కనిపిస్తోంది., Hindi: मक्का के गोभ में बड़े छेद हो गए हैं और लकड़ी के बुरादे जैसा मल भरा है।). Crop: Maize. Category: Pest Management. Scientific Solution: This is Fall Armyworm (Spodoptera frugiperda). Apply dry sand or wood ash into whorls immediately. Spray Coragen 18.5% SC @ 80 ml/acre (6 ml per 15L pump) directed straight into leaf whorls..

title: KCC FAQ: kcc-faq-008 (Groundnut / Peanut)
content: Farmer Query: Groundnut lower leaves have circular dark brown spots with bright yellow halo. Leaves are falling. (Telugu: వేరుశనగ ఆకులపై గుండ్రటి నల్లటి మచ్చలు పసుపు రంగు వలయంతో ఉన్నాయి, ఆకులు రాలిపోతున్నాయి., Hindi: मूंगफली की पत्तियों पर पीले घेरे वाले काले धब्बे बन रहे हैं और पत्ते झड़ रहे हैं।). Crop: Groundnut / Peanut. Category: Disease Management. Scientific Solution: This is Tikka Leaf Spot (Cercospora). Spray Saaf 75% WP (Carbendazim + Mancozeb) @ 400 g/acre (30 g per 15L pump) or Custodia @ 300 ml/acre in 200 L water..

title: KCC FAQ: kcc-faq-009 (Wheat)
content: Farmer Query: Wheat leaves have yellow parallel stripes like turmeric powder adhering to fingers when touched. What is it? (Telugu: గోధుమ ఆకులపై పసుపు రంగు చారలు ఉన్నాయి, తాకితే పసుపు పొడి అంటుకుంటోంది., Hindi: गेहूं के पत्तों पर हल्दी जैसा पीला पाउडर धारियों में दिख रहा है, छूने पर हाथ पर लगता है।). Crop: Wheat. Category: Disease Management. Scientific Solution: This is Yellow / Stripe Rust (Puccinia striiformis). Immediately spray Tilt 25% EC (Propiconazole) @ 200 ml/acre (15 ml per 15L pump) in 200 L water upon first detection..
citation: ICAR-IIWBR Karnal Wheat Rust Alert & KCC 2025

title: KCC FAQ: kcc-faq-010 (Tomato)
content: Farmer Query: Can I spray Monocrotophos on tomato or brinjal for fruit borer? (Telugu: టమోటా లేదా వంగ పంటలో పురుగుల కోసం మోనోక్రోటోఫాస్ పిచికారీ చేయవచ్చా?, Hindi: क्या मैं टमाटर या बैंगन पर मोनोक्रोटोफॉस का छिड़काव कर सकता हूँ?). Crop: Tomato. Category: Chemical Safety Alert. Scientific Solution: STRICTLY PROHIBITED: Monocrotophos is BANNED for use on all vegetables by CIBRC and Government of India due to extreme neurotoxicity and fatal dietary residues. Spray Coragen 18.5% SC @ 60 ml/acre or Fame @ 60 ml/acre instead..
citation: CIBRC Statutory Ban Notification & KCC Critical Protocol 2025

title: KCC FAQ: kcc-faq-011 (Rice / Paddy)
content: Farmer Query: My paddy rice grains are turning empty and chaffy, and neck node is blackened. (Telugu: వరి కంకి మెడ నల్లబడి విరిగిపోతోంది, గింజలు తాలుగా మారుతున్నాయి., Hindi: धान की बाली की गर्दन काली होकर टूट रही है और दाने थोथे (खाली) हो रहे हैं।). Crop: Rice / Paddy. Category: Disease Management. Scientific Solution: This is Neck Blast (Magnaporthe oryzae). Spray Nativo 75% WG @ 80 g/acre or Amistar Top @ 200 ml/acre at 50% heading stage to protect panicle necks..

title: KCC FAQ: kcc-faq-012 (Cotton)
content: Farmer Query: Cotton squares are dropping heavily in 60-day crop. What is the remedy? (Telugu: 60 రోజుల పత్తి చేనులో పూత, పిందె (కాయలు) విపరీతంగా రాలిపోతున్నాయి. ఏమి చేయాలి?, Hindi: कपास में कलियां और फूल बहुत ज्यादा झड़ रहे हैं। क्या उपाय करें?). Crop: Cotton. Category: Agronomy & Protection. Scientific Solution: Check for Pink Bollworm (rosette flowers). If no larvae, square drop is due to moisture stress or boron deficiency. Spray Planofix (NAA 4.5% SL) @ 4 ml per 15L pump + Solubor (Boron 20%) @ 1.5 g/L..

title: KCC FAQ: kcc-faq-013 (Groundnut / Peanut)
content: Farmer Query: How much Gypsum should I apply in groundnut and when? (Telugu: వేరుశనగలో జిప్సం ఎంత మోతాదులో, ఎప్పుడు వేయాలి?, Hindi: मूंगफली में जिप्सम कब और कितनी मात्रा में डालना चाहिए?). Crop: Groundnut / Peanut. Category: Nutrient Management. Scientific Solution: Apply Gypsum @ 200 kg/acre at 40-45 DAS (pegging stage). Place 5 cm away from plant rows and incorporate lightly. Supplies Calcium and Sulphur essential for pod shell hardening and bold kernel filling..

title: KCC FAQ: kcc-faq-014 (Rice / Paddy)
content: Farmer Query: My rice seedlings show rusty brown spots on leaves 20 days after transplanting, and growth is stunted. (Telugu: వరి నాట్లు వేసిన 20 రోజులకు ఆకులపై తుప్పు మచ్చలు వచ్చి ఎదగడం లేదు., Hindi: धान की रोपाई के 20 दिन बाद पत्तियों पर कत्थई/भूरे रंग के धब्बे दिख रहे हैं और पौधे छोटे रह गए हैं।). Crop: Rice / Paddy. Category: Nutrient Deficiency. Scientific Solution: This is Zinc deficiency (Khaira disease). Spray Zinc Sulphate (21%) @ 2 g/L + Slaked lime @ 1 g/L twice at 5-day intervals. For future crops, apply 20 kg/acre Zinc Sulphate basal..

title: KCC FAQ: kcc-faq-015 (Soybean)
content: Farmer Query: What herbicide to spray in standing soybean crop for grass and broadleaf weeds? (Telugu: సోయాబీన్ చేనులో మొలక వచ్చిన తర్వాత గడ్డి మరియు వెడల్పాకు కలుపు నివారణకు ఏమి కొట్టాలి?, Hindi: सोयाबीन की खड़ी फसल में घास और चौड़ी पत्ती वाले खरपतवार के लिए कौन सी दवा डालें?). Crop: Soybean. Category: Weed Management. Scientific Solution: Spray Pursuit (Imazethapyr 10% SL) @ 350 ml/acre (25 ml per 15L pump) at 15-20 DAS when weeds are at 2-3 leaf stage into moist soil..

title: KCC FAQ: kcc-faq-016 (Sugarcane)
content: Farmer Query: Sugarcane young shoots are drying up with foul smell and dead heart. What is the pest? (Telugu: చెరకు మొవ్వు ఎండిపోయి వాసన వస్తోంది, లాగితే తేలికగా వచ్చేస్తోంది., Hindi: गन्ने की नई गोभ सूखकर बदबू मार रही है और खींचने पर आसानी से निकल आती है।). Crop: Sugarcane. Category: Pest Management. Scientific Solution: This is Early Shoot Borer (Chilo infuscatellus). Trash mulching across rows. Direct soil drenching of Coragen 18.5% SC @ 150 ml/acre along cane rows at 35 DAP followed by irrigation..

title: KCC FAQ: kcc-faq-017 (Onion)
content: Farmer Query: Onion leaves are drying from tips and developing white silvery streaks with small insects in neck. (Telugu: ఉల్లి ఆకులు చివర్ల నుండి ఎండిపోతూ వెండి రంగు చారలు వస్తున్నాయి., Hindi: प्याज के पत्ते ऊपर से सूख रहे हैं और सफेद चांदी जैसी धारियां दिख रही हैं।). Crop: Onion. Category: Pest Management. Scientific Solution: This is Onion Thrips. Erect blue sticky traps @ 20/acre. Spray Pegasus 50% WP (Diafenthiuron) @ 240 g/acre (18 g per 15L pump) with sticker targeting leaf sheath bases..

title: KCC FAQ: kcc-faq-018 (Cotton)
content: Farmer Query: What is the recommended seed rate and spacing for Bt Cotton in black soil? (Telugu: నల్లరేగడి నేలలో బిటి పత్తికి విత్తన మోతాదు మరియు ఎడం ఎంత ఉండాలి?, Hindi: काली मिट्टी में बीटी कपास की बीज दर और कतार से कतार की दूरी कितनी होनी चाहिए?). Crop: Cotton. Category: Agronomy. Scientific Solution: Bt cotton requires 2 packets (900 g total) per acre. Spacing in normal black soils is 90 cm row-to-row and 60 cm plant-to-plant (7,400 plants/acre). Plant non-Bt refuge border rows around field..

title: KCC FAQ: kcc-faq-019 (Wheat)
content: Farmer Query: Can I mix Coragen and Tilt together in the same tank for wheat spray? (Telugu: గోధుమలో పురుగు మరియు తెగులు నివారణకు ఒకే పంపులో కొరాజెన్ మరియు టిల్ట్ మందులను కలిపి కొట్టవచ్చా?, Hindi: क्या मैं गेहूं में कोराजन और टिल्ट को एक ही स्प्रे पंप में मिलाकर छिड़क सकता हूँ?). Crop: Wheat. Category: Chemical Safety Alert. Scientific Solution: UNAPPROVED TANK MIX: Do NOT combine separate commercial pesticides in the same spray tank without CIBRC statutory co-formulation registration. Tank cocktails cause chemical antagonism, nozzle clogging, and leaf scorching..
citation: CIBRC Safety Directive & KCC Tank Mix Alert 2025

title: KCC FAQ: kcc-faq-020 (Potato)
content: Farmer Query: Potato leaves are turning black water-soaked overnight during cold cloudy days. (Telugu: చలి, మబ్బుల వాతావరణంలో బంగాళాదుంప ఆకులు రాత్రికి రాత్రే నల్లబడి కుళ్ళిపోతున్నాయి., Hindi: कोहरे और बादलों वाले मौसम में आलू के पत्ते रातों-रात काले पड़कर सड़ रहे हैं।). Crop: Potato. Category: Disease Management. Scientific Solution: This is Late Blight (Phytophthora infestans) epidemic. Immediately spray Ridomil Gold (Metalaxyl-M + Mancozeb) @ 500 g/acre (37.5 g per 15L pump) in 200 L water..

title: KCC FAQ: kcc-faq-021 (Wheat)
content: Farmer Query: What is the critical stage of irrigation in wheat where water should never be missed? (Telugu: గోధుమ పంటలో ఎట్టి పరిస్థితుల్లోనూ తప్పనిసరిగా నీరు ఇవ్వాల్సిన దశ ఏది?, Hindi: गेहूं में सिंचाई की सबसे महत्वपूर्ण क्रांतिक अवस्था कौन सी है?). Crop: Wheat. Category: Irrigation. Scientific Solution: Crown Root Initiation (CRI at 20-25 DAS) is the most critical stage. Skipping irrigation at CRI reduces wheat yield by up to 35-40% permanently..

title: KCC FAQ: kcc-faq-022 (Turmeric)
content: Farmer Query: Turmeric pseudostem collar is rotting and leaves are turning yellow from margin inward. (Telugu: పసుపు మొదలు కుళ్ళిపోతోంది, మొక్క లాగితే ఊడివస్తోంది, ఆకులు పసుపు రంగులోకి మారాయి., Hindi: हल्दी के तने का निचला हिस्सा सड़ रहा है और पत्ते पीले पड़ रहे हैं।). Crop: Turmeric. Category: Disease Management. Scientific Solution: This is Rhizome Rot / Soft Rot (Pythium). Provide immediate drainage. Drench collar root zone with Ridomil Gold @ 2.5 g/L or Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 3 g/L..

title: KCC FAQ: kcc-faq-023 (Red Gram / Pigeonpea)
content: Farmer Query: Pigeonpea plants are wilting suddenly on one side with purple-black streak inside stem. (Telugu: కంది చెట్లు ఒకవైపు ఎండిపోతున్నాయి, కాండం చీల్చి చూస్తే లోపల నల్లటి చార కనిపిస్తోంది., Hindi: अरहर के पौधे एक तरफ से मुरझा रहे हैं और तना चीरने पर अंदर काली धारी दिखती है।). Crop: Red Gram / Pigeonpea. Category: Disease Management. Scientific Solution: This is Fusarium Wilt. No chemical cure exists once vascular wilt establishes. Drench healthy surrounding plants with Carbendazim @ 1 g/L. In future, grow resistant varieties like Asha (ICPL 87119) and treat seed with Trichoderma viride..

title: KCC FAQ: kcc-faq-024 (Mustard / Rapeseed)
content: Farmer Query: Mustard floral shoots are covered with dense green aphids. How to spray without harming honeybees? (Telugu: ఆవాల పూతపై నల్లటి పేనుబంక ఉంది. తేనెటీగలకు హాని కలగకుండా ఎలా మందు కొట్టాలి?, Hindi: सरसों के फूलों पर माहू लगा है। मधुमक्खियों को नुकसान पहुँचाए बिना कैसे दवा छिड़कें?). Crop: Mustard / Rapeseed. Category: Pest & Bee Safety. Scientific Solution: Spray during late afternoon (after 4:30 PM) when honeybees have returned to hives. Apply Actara 25% WG (Thiamethoxam) @ 40 g/acre or Dimethoate 30% EC @ 260 ml/acre..

title: KCC FAQ: kcc-faq-025 (Pulses)
content: Farmer Query: How to prevent pulse beetles from destroying stored red gram and chickpea seeds? (Telugu: నిల్వ చేసిన కందులు మరియు శనగలను ముక్కుపురుగు (కాయ తొలుచు పురుగు) తినకుండా ఎలా కాపాడుకోవాలి?, Hindi: भंडारण में दालों और चने को घुन/सूंड़ी से कैसे बचाएं?). Crop: Pulses. Category: Post-Harvest Storage. Scientific Solution: Dry seeds below 9% moisture. Store in 3-layer PICS hermetic bags which starve insects of oxygen. Alternatively, coat seeds with neem oil or edible castor oil @ 5 ml per kg seed..

title: KCC FAQ: kcc-faq-026 (Rice / Paddy)
content: Farmer Query: My paddy crop was caught in cyclone rain and grains are soaked. How to stop grains from sprouting? (Telugu: తుఫాను వర్షానికి వరి చేను నీటమునిగింది, కంకులపైనే గింజలు మొలకెత్తకుండా ఏమి చేయాలి?, Hindi: बारिश से धान की बालियां भीग गई हैं, बालियों में ही दाने उगने से कैसे रोकें?). Crop: Rice / Paddy. Category: Contingency Rescue. Scientific Solution: Spray 5% common salt solution (50 g cooking salt per liter water) directly on standing panicles. The high salt osmotic pressure prevents viviparous grain germination for 5-7 days..

title: KCC FAQ: kcc-faq-027 (Cotton & Chilli)
content: Farmer Query: What is the pre-harvest interval (PHI) for Proclaim on Cotton and Tracer on Chilli? (Telugu: పత్తిలో ప్రొక్లెయిమ్ మరియు మిరపలో ట్రేసర్ పిచికారీ చేసిన ఎన్ని రోజులకు పంట కోయాలి?, Hindi: कपास में प्रोक्लेम और मिर्च में ट्रेसर डालने के कितने दिन बाद तुड़ाई करनी चाहिए?). Crop: Cotton & Chilli. Category: Statutory Chemical Safety. Scientific Solution: CIBRC Mandatory Waiting Periods (PHI): Proclaim 5% SG on Cotton requires a 14-day PHI; Tracer 45% SC on Chilli requires a 3-day PHI. Do not harvest crop before these statutory periods expire..

title: KCC FAQ: kcc-faq-028 (All Crops)
content: Farmer Query: My black soil has pH 8.8 and water stagnates on surface. What amendment should I apply? (Telugu: నా నేల క్షార గుణం (pH 8.8) కలిగి ఉంది, నీరు ఇంకడం లేదు. ఏ మట్టి దిద్దుబాటు వేయాలి?, Hindi: मेरी जमीन क्षारीय (pH 8.8) है और पानी सोखती नहीं है। क्या सुधार करें?). Crop: All Crops. Category: Soil Reclamation. Scientific Solution: This is sodic/alkaline soil. Apply agricultural grade Gypsum @ 2-3 tonnes/acre based on Gypsum Requirement test, broadcast, mix in top 10 cm, and pond water to leach displaced sodium. Incorporate green manure Dhaincha..

title: KCC FAQ: kcc-faq-029 (Mustard / Rapeseed)
content: Farmer Query: White porcelain blisters appeared on mustard leaf undersides. What is this? (Telugu: ఆవాల ఆకుల అడుగున తెల్లటి పొక్కులు వచ్చాయి. పూత విచిత్రంగా మారిపోయింది., Hindi: सरसों के पत्तों के नीचे सफेद रंग के छाले (फफोले) बन गए हैं और फूल विकृत हो गए हैं।). Crop: Mustard / Rapeseed. Category: Disease Management. Scientific Solution: This is White Rust (Albugo candida) and staghead malformation. Spray Ridomil Gold @ 2.5 g/L or Dithane M-45 @ 2 g/L upon first detection..

title: KCC FAQ: kcc-faq-030 (General Agriculture)
content: Farmer Query: How can I contact my Mandal Agricultural Officer (MAO) in Telangana for seed subsidy and soil testing? (Telugu: తెలంగాణలో విత్తనాల సబ్సిడీ మరియు సాయిల్ టెస్ట్ కోసం మండల వ్యవసాయ అధికారి (MAO) ని ఎలా సంప్రదించాలి?, Hindi: बीज सब्सिडी और मिट्टी परीक्षण के लिए कृषि अधिकारी से कैसे संपर्क करें?). Crop: General Agriculture. Category: Extension Directory. Scientific Solution: Visit your local Rythu Vedika or Mandal Agriculture Office during working hours (10:30 AM to 5:00 PM). Alternatively, dial the National Kisan Call Center toll-free helpline at 1800-180-1551..
citation: Department of Agriculture Govt of Telangana 2025

title: Officer Resolution: case-res-001 (Cotton)
content: Field Case [case-res-001]: Location: Narsampet Mandal, Warangal District, Telangana. Crop: Cotton (110 DAS (Boll Development Stage)). Problem: Bolls dropping prematurely, and green bolls have small dark pinholes with lint inside turning brownish-pink.. Diagnosis: Pink Bollworm (Pectinophora gossypiella) internal locule damage. Green boll destructive sampling showed 14% damaged bolls with 3rd instar pink larvae feeding inside seeds.. Certified Remediation: Install 8 Pectino-lure pheromone traps per acre immediately to monitor and mass-trap male moths. Manual collection and burning of rosette flowers and shed bolls. Foliar spray of CIBRC registered Proclaim 5% SG (Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG) @ 88 g/acre (6.6 g per 15L backpack pump in 200 L water/acre). Maintain statutory pre-harvest interval of 14 days before cotton picking. Terminate standing crop by end of December; avoid ratooning.. Sign-off: Dr. K. Srinivas Rao, Mandal Agricultural Officer (MAO), Narsampet (TS-AGRI-MAO-0412) on 2025-10-18.

title: Officer Resolution: case-res-002 (Rice / Paddy)
content: Field Case [case-res-002]: Location: Banswada Mandal, Kamareddy District, Telangana. Crop: Rice / Paddy (65 DAT (Booting / Panicle Initiation Stage)). Problem: Circular patches of crop turning dry and yellow; base of rice hills completely covered with thousands of small brown insects.. Diagnosis: Brown Plant Hopper (Nilaparvata lugens) hopper burn outbreak at critical booting stage. Hopper count averaged 45 insects per hill (severe economic damage threshold).. Certified Remediation: Immediately drain standing canal water from field for 4 consecutive days. Create walking alleys (skipping/parting 1 row after every 8 rows) to admit sunlight and ventilation to the plant bases. Apply Chess 50% WG (Pymetrozine 50% WG) @ 120 g/acre (9 g per 15L knapsack pump) with flat-fan nozzle directed strictly onto stem bases. Strictly avoid synthetic pyrethroid sprays to prevent secondary resurgence.. Sign-off: M. Anjaneyulu, Assistant Director of Agriculture (ADA), Banswada (TS-AGRI-ADA-0198) on 2025-10-24.

title: Officer Resolution: case-res-003 (Chilli)
content: Field Case [case-res-003]: Location: Tadikonda Mandal, Guntur District, Andhra Pradesh. Crop: Chilli (45 DAT (Active Vegetative & Early Flowering)). Problem: Top tender leaves curling upwards like boat hulls, leaf margins bronzed and brittle, flower bud abortion.. Diagnosis: Severe Chilli Thrips (Scirtothrips dorsalis) infestation. Lacerations visible on undersides of apical leaves. Average count 6 thrips per leaf.. Certified Remediation: Erect 20 blue sticky traps per acre at crop canopy height. Foliar spray of Pegasus 50% WP (Diafenthiuron 50% WP) @ 240 g/acre (18 g per 15L backpack pump in 200 L water/acre). Maintain 7-day pre-harvest interval. Follow up with Neem oil 1500 ppm @ 2 ml/L after 10 days.. Sign-off: Smt. P. Lakshmi Devi, Mandal Agricultural Officer (MAO), Tadikonda (AP-AGRI-MAO-0824) on 2025-09-12.

title: Officer Resolution: case-res-004 (Turmeric)
content: Field Case [case-res-004]: Location: Armoor Mandal, Nizamabad District, Telangana. Crop: Turmeric (110 DAP (Grand Growth & Rhizome Initiation)). Problem: Central leaves drying from tip down, pseudostem base soft and rotten, emits foul smell, rhizomes rotting in waterlogged patches.. Diagnosis: Rhizome Rot / Soft Rot (Pythium aphanidermatum) compounded by severe surface drainage congestion during heavy August downpour.. Certified Remediation: Open deep drainage channels at 5-meter intervals to evacuate stagnant water immediately. Remove and destroy severely rotted clumps outside field. Drench pseudostem collars with Ridomil Gold (Metalaxyl 4% + Mancozeb 64% WP) @ 2.5 g/L (37.5 g per 15L pump) using 300 ml solution per clump. Incorporate neem cake @ 150 kg/acre along with Trichoderma viride around remaining healthy beds.. Sign-off: V. Rajeshwar, Agricultural Extension Officer (AEO), Armoor (TS-AGRI-AEO-1156) on 2025-08-28.

title: Officer Resolution: case-res-005 (Soybean)
content: Field Case [case-res-005]: Location: Sanwer Tehsil, Indore District, Madhya Pradesh. Crop: Soybean (40 DAS (Flowering Stage)). Problem: Leaves showing extensive windowpanes, larvae cutting leaf edges and looping, heavy defoliation.. Diagnosis: Semilooper (Chrysodeixis acuta) outbreak. Caterpillar count: 6 larvae per meter row length (above economic threshold level of 3-4 larvae/meter).. Certified Remediation: Foliar spray of Fame 39.35% SC (Flubendiamide 39.35% SC) @ 60 ml/acre (4.5 ml per 15L backpack pump). Observe 30-day statutory PHI. Erect 15 T-shaped bird perches per acre.. Sign-off: R. K. Sharma, Senior Agriculture Development Officer (SADO), Sanwer (MP-AGRI-SADO-0331) on 2025-08-14.

title: Officer Resolution: case-res-006 (Wheat)
content: Field Case [case-res-006]: Location: Jagraon Block, Ludhiana District, Punjab. Crop: Wheat (65 DAS (Late Jointing / Flag Leaf Emergence)). Problem: Linear bright yellow powdery stripes appearing on flag leaves across 2 acres.. Diagnosis: Yellow / Stripe Rust (Puccinia striiformis f. sp. tritici) initial foci under cool foggy conditions.. Certified Remediation: Immediately spray Tilt 25% EC (Propiconazole 25% EC) @ 200 ml/acre (15 ml per 15L backpack pump) in 200 L water/acre. Ensure 30-day PHI. Survey adjacent wheat fields for community containment.. Sign-off: Dr. Gurpreet Singh, Agriculture Development Officer (ADO), Jagraon (PB-AGRI-ADO-0544) on 2025-01-20.

title: Officer Resolution: case-res-007 (Tomato)
content: Field Case [case-res-007]: Location: Niphad Taluka, Nashik District, Maharashtra. Crop: Tomato (55 DAT (Fruit Setting & Sizing)). Problem: Round holes in developing fruits with caterpillar head feeding inside; circular concentric ring spots on lower leaves.. Diagnosis: Tomato Fruit Borer (Helicoverpa armigera) combined with Early Blight (Alternaria solani).. Certified Remediation: Coragen 18.5% SC (Chlorantraniliprole) @ 60 ml/acre (4.5 ml per 15L pump) for Fruit Borer (PHI 3 days). Dithane M-45 (Mancozeb 75% WP) @ 600 g/acre (45 g per 15L pump) for Early Blight (PHI 5 days). Apply in separate sequential sprays or verify statutory label approvals.. Sign-off: Suresh B. Patil, Mandal Krishi Adhikari (MKA), Niphad (MH-AGRI-MKA-0719) on 2025-10-05.

title: Officer Resolution: case-res-008 (Bengal Gram / Chickpea)
content: Field Case [case-res-008]: Location: Nandyal Mandal, Nandyal District, Andhra Pradesh. Crop: Bengal Gram / Chickpea (70 DAS (Pod Development Stage)). Problem: Larvae chewing green chickpea pods, boreholes with caterpillar head thrust inside.. Diagnosis: Gram Pod Borer (Helicoverpa armigera). Larval population: 2 larvae per meter row.. Certified Remediation: Foliar spray of Proclaim 5% SG (Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG) @ 88 g/acre (6.6 g per 15L backpack pump). Observe 14-day pre-harvest interval. Install 4 Helilure pheromone traps per acre.. Sign-off: K. Venkateswarlu, Mandal Agricultural Officer (MAO), Nandyal (AP-AGRI-MAO-0912) on 2025-12-19.

title: Officer Resolution: case-res-009 (Mustard / Rapeseed)
content: Field Case [case-res-009]: Location: Kumher Tehsil, Bharatpur District, Rajasthan. Crop: Mustard / Rapeseed (75 DAS (Siliquae / Pod Formation)). Problem: Inflorescence and pods encrusted with green aphids, honeydew mold coating upper twigs.. Diagnosis: Mustard Aphid (Lipaphis erysimi) heavy infestation (>35% plants infested).. Certified Remediation: Spray Rogor 30% EC (Dimethoate 30% EC) @ 264 ml/acre (20 ml per 15L backpack pump) in late afternoon. Ensure 15-day PHI. Avoid spraying while honeybees are actively pollinating.. Sign-off: Manohar Lal Meena, Assistant Agriculture Officer (AAO), Kumher (RJ-AGRI-AAO-0215) on 2025-01-28.

title: Officer Resolution: case-res-010 (Rice / Paddy)
content: Field Case [case-res-010]: Location: Miryalaguda Mandal, Nalgonda District, Telangana. Crop: Rice / Paddy (50 DAT (Panicle Initiation)). Problem: Snake-skin shaped greenish-grey lesions with dark brown borders on lower leaf sheaths at waterline.. Diagnosis: Sheath Blight (Rhizoctonia solani). Lesions ascending from water line to 3rd leaf sheath.. Certified Remediation: Drain field water slightly to expose lower stems to air. Spray Contaf 5% SC (Hexaconazole 5% SC) @ 400 ml/acre (30 ml per 15L backpack pump) directed at stem bases. Observe 30-day PHI.. Sign-off: G. Madhusudhan Reddy, Mandal Agricultural Officer (MAO), Miryalaguda (TS-AGRI-MAO-0651) on 2025-09-30.

title: Officer Resolution: case-res-011 (Sugarcane)
content: Field Case [case-res-011]: Location: Kopargaon Taluka, Ahmednagar District, Maharashtra. Crop: Sugarcane (60 DAP (Tillering / Formative Stage)). Problem: Dead hearts in young shoots, central spindle dried and pulling out with rotting odor.. Diagnosis: Early Shoot Borer (Chilo infuscatellus). Dead heart percentage: 18% (above 15% threshold).. Certified Remediation: Soil directed drench of Coragen 18.5% SC (Chlorantraniliprole) @ 150 ml/acre along cane rows followed by light irrigation. Trash mulching in alternate furrows. Observe 45-day PHI.. Sign-off: D. N. Gholap, Taluka Agriculture Officer (TAO), Kopargaon (MH-AGRI-TAO-0482) on 2025-04-12.

title: Officer Resolution: case-res-012 (Potato)
content: Field Case [case-res-012]: Location: Sadar Tehsil, Agra District, Uttar Pradesh. Crop: Potato (50 DAP (Tuber Bulking Stage)). Problem: Dark water-soaked necrotic blighting on leaf tips; white delicate downy mold on underside in early morning.. Diagnosis: Late Blight (Phytophthora infestans) triggered by 3 days of dense fog and low temperatures (14°C).. Certified Remediation: Foliar spray of Ridomil Gold (Metalaxyl-M 4% + Mancozeb 64% WP) @ 500 g/acre (37.5 g per 15L backpack pump). Observe 14-day PHI. High earthing up to protect tubers.. Sign-off: Anil Kumar Yadav, District Horticulture Officer (DHO), Agra (UP-HORT-DHO-0112) on 2025-12-22.

title: Officer Resolution: case-res-013 (Maize)
content: Field Case [case-res-013]: Location: Yellandu Mandal, Bhadradri Kothagudem District, Telangana. Crop: Maize (25 DAS (Knee-high Stage)). Problem: Shot holes and large irregular papery windowpanes on leaves with larvae inside whorl.. Diagnosis: Fall Armyworm (Spodoptera frugiperda) early whorl damage (12% infested plants).. Certified Remediation: Directed spray of Delegate 11.7% SC (Spinetoram 11.7% SC) @ 180 ml/acre (13.5 ml per 15L pump) into whorl funnel. Observe 14-day PHI. Erect T-shaped bird perches.. Sign-off: B. Thirupathi, Agricultural Extension Officer (AEO), Yellandu (TS-AGRI-AEO-1402) on 2025-07-28.

title: Officer Resolution: case-res-014 (Onion)
content: Field Case [case-res-014]: Location: Dhone Mandal, Nandyal District, Andhra Pradesh. Crop: Onion (70 DAT (Bulb Enlargement Stage)). Problem: Purple-centered elliptical spots with yellow halos on leaves, leaves drying from tip down.. Diagnosis: Purple Blotch (Alternaria porri) exacerbated by thrips lacerations.. Certified Remediation: Spray Custodia (Azoxystrobin + Tebuconazole) @ 300 ml/acre (22.5 ml per 15L pump) + Pegasus 50% WP @ 240 g/acre with sticker. Observe 5-day PHI. Avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation.. Sign-off: T. Ramanjaneyulu, Mandal Agricultural Officer (MAO), Dhone (AP-AGRI-MAO-0985) on 2025-02-16.

title: Officer Resolution: case-res-015 (Tomato)
content: Field Case [case-res-015]: Location: Ghatkesar Mandal, Medchal-Malkajgiri District, Telangana. Crop: Tomato (35 DAT (Flowering & First Fruit Set)). Problem: Severe upward leaf curling, extreme puckering, stunted bush appearance with no flower set.. Diagnosis: Tomato Leaf Curl Virus (ToLCV) transmitted by Whitefly (Bemisia tabaci).. Certified Remediation: Rogue out and bury severely infected stunted plants immediately. Spray Token 20% SG (Dinotefuran 20% SG) @ 80 g/acre or Actara 25% WG @ 40 g/acre to control whitefly vector. Install yellow sticky traps @ 20 traps/acre.. Sign-off: K. Sravanthi, Mandal Agricultural Officer (MAO), Ghatkesar (TS-AGRI-MAO-0314) on 2025-08-09.

title: Officer Resolution: case-res-016 (Cotton)
content: Field Case [case-res-016]: Location: Dharampuri Tehsil, Dhar District, Madhya Pradesh. Crop: Cotton (50 DAS (Early Squaring)). Problem: Leaf edges curling downward, turning yellow then reddish-brown, sideways walking nymphs on leaf undersides.. Diagnosis: Cotton Jassids / Leafhopper (Amrasca biguttula biguttula) hopper burn.. Certified Remediation: Foliar spray of Ulala 50% WG (Flonicamid 50% WG) @ 80 g/acre (6.0 g per 15L backpack pump). Observe 20-day PHI. Install yellow sticky traps.. Sign-off: M. P. Patidar, Sub-Divisional Agriculture Officer (SDAO), Dhar (MP-AGRI-SDAO-0177) on 2025-08-02.

title: Officer Resolution: case-res-017 (Paddy / Rice)
content: Field Case [case-res-017]: Location: Samrala Block, Ludhiana District, Punjab. Crop: Paddy / Rice (40 DAT (Tillering)). Problem: Central shoots turning straw-colored and drying (dead hearts), easily detached upon slight pull.. Diagnosis: Yellow Stem Borer (Scirpophaga incertulas). Dead heart incidence: 7% (above 5% ETL).. Certified Remediation: Foliar spray of Caldan 50% SP (Cartap Hydrochloride 50% SP) @ 400 g/acre (30 g per 15L pump). Observe 21-day PHI. Clip seedling tips in future nurseries.. Sign-off: Harpal Singh, Agriculture Development Officer (ADO), Samrala (PB-AGRI-ADO-0628) on 2025-08-20.

title: Officer Resolution: case-res-018 (Rice / Paddy)
content: Field Case [case-res-018]: Location: Jagtial Mandal, Jagtial District, Telangana. Crop: Rice / Paddy (75 DAT (Panicle Heading)). Problem: Water-soaked translucent streaks on leaf margins turning wavy yellowish-white with bacterial ooze beads.. Diagnosis: Bacterial Leaf Blight (Xanthomonas oryzae pv. oryzae).. Certified Remediation: Drain standing water and stop top-dressing urea immediately. Spray Streptocycline @ 24 g/acre + Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 500 g/acre in 200 L water. Observe 15-day PHI.. Sign-off: Ch. Narender Reddy, Mandal Agricultural Officer (MAO), Jagtial (TS-AGRI-MAO-0205) on 2025-09-18.

title: Officer Resolution: case-res-019 (Black Gram / Urad)
content: Field Case [case-res-019]: Location: Madira Mandal, Khammam District, Telangana. Crop: Black Gram / Urad (35 DAS (Flowering)). Problem: Leaves showing bright yellow mosaic patches interspersed with dark green blistered areas; flowers dropping.. Diagnosis: Mungbean Yellow Mosaic Virus (MYMV) vectored by Whitefly (Bemisia tabaci).. Certified Remediation: Rogue out initial infected yellow plants. Spray Actara 25% WG (Thiamethoxam 25% WG) @ 40 g/acre (3 g per 15L pump) to knock down whitefly vector. Install yellow sticky traps @ 20/acre.. Sign-off: N. Venkata Rao, Mandal Agricultural Officer (MAO), Madira (TS-AGRI-MAO-0590) on 2025-08-11.

title: Officer Resolution: case-res-020 (Mustard)
content: Field Case [case-res-020]: Location: Kupwara / Jammu District, Jammu & Kashmir. Crop: Mustard (60 DAS (Flowering)). Problem: White blister-like pustules on lower leaves; floral heads swollen and distorted into stagheads.. Diagnosis: White Rust (Albugo candida) systemic staghead infection.. Certified Remediation: Clip and destroy staghead malformations. Foliar spray of Ridomil Gold (Metalaxyl 4% + Mancozeb 64% WP) @ 500 g/acre (37.5 g per 15L pump). Observe 14-day PHI.. Sign-off: Bashir Ahmad Lone, Sub-Divisional Agriculture Officer (SDAO), Kupwara (JK-AGRI-SDAO-0082) on 2025-03-04.
